This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Amsterdam Airport Schiphol Station in degrees Celsius on 10 May '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day by the Forecast for the Amsterdam Airport Schiphol Station once information is finalized, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/nl/schiphol/EHAM.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve to "Yes" until all data for this date has been finalized.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Any revisions to temperatures recorded after data is finalized for this market's timeframe will not be considered for this market's resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket closely splits between 15°C (36%) and 16°C (37%) as the highest temperature at Amsterdam Airport Schiphol on May 10, driven by the latest KNMI guidance and ECMWF ensemble forecasts projecting mean highs around 16°C with a tight spread of 15-17°C. This reflects uncertainty in afternoon cloud cover under a northerly to easterly flow capping warming, alongside a building high-pressure ridge east of the Netherlands introducing variable solar insolation. Historical mid-May highs at Schiphol average 16°C, aligning with climatological norms, though light winds and marine influence could nudge outcomes lower or higher. Hourly observations through evening will clarify as models diverge on exact timing of clearing skies.
